guidance: Be Ready household campaign: water (3 litres per person per day), food that needs no cooking, a torch, a radio, medicines and cash.

Ready.gov basic kit: one gallon of water per person per day, non-perishable food, a battery or hand-crank radio, a flashlight, a first aid kit and a phone backup battery. No new federal figure in this period; the 30-day figure came from a podcast host, not a government.
Preparedness Union Strategy: households should manage on their own for at least 72 hours. Non-binding.
Nationwide request due on November 2, when the new Disaster Management Agency launches. The stated reason is natural disasters such as a Nankai Trough megaquake.
officialLabel: No official page yet; reported by IBTimes UK and Business Today

guidance: Sweden at least a week, Norway a week (up from three days), Austria 10 to 14 days. France, Ireland and the Netherlands use three days.
